It must look like an appealing original little cartoon character, NOT a realistic face, NOT a traced portrait, NOT a digital headshot, NOT a detailed adult portrait. Preserve only the key identity traits: ordinary HUMAN adult man, round plump face, dark glasses, short dark hair, neat beard and moustache. Exaggerated cartoon proportions: very large soft round cheeks, oversized simple glasses, a tiny simple human nose, small lively dot/short-arc eyes rather than realistic eyes, short simple eyebrows, a cheerful small relaxed smile. Head very large with only a tiny suggestion of sweater collar or shoulders beneath it; the face should dominate. Make the hair and short beard into clean bold solid navy shapes, no individual strands. A slightly whimsical, studious, warm, friendly personality. Draw like a charming modern comic-strip character or hand-inked sticker with bold gently imperfect outlines and just 3 flat colors: warm peach skin, deep navy hair/glasses/beard, muted cream or pale blue collar. Avoid face modeling, skin shading, realistic lips, detailed irises, gradients, 3D, generic corporate avatar realism. It must read immediately as a memorable cartoon character at 36px, with unmistakable glasses and beard. Single centered complete head with tiny collar, square composition, genuinely transparent background and modest padding. Strictly human anatomy: normal human ears and a tiny human nose. NO animal traits, no pig, no snout, no animal ears, no tusks. No text, no books, no stars, no props, no multi-option sheet.
